svg.title: How each job sees the garage: working_state
svg.desc: Every Plan<Type>Job copies ctx->initial_state and replays all events planned so far, so a later job sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Every Plan<Type>Job starts the same way: copy ctx->initial_state, then replay the whole event DAG built so far. Job 1 therefore plans against the garage that job 0 will leave

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
